metadata.title: That 1 kill where I wasn’t even ready and Valorant said ‘Here, take this’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I swear I was just standing there!
Enemy just handed me a kill and left me shook.
Click if your best plays come from pure dumb luck.
Valorant logic is peak trolling again.

Tap if your kills feel like unwanted gifts!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
